[ ONE PLATFORM ]

Bifrost Edge + Bifrost Gateway.
Coverage for every AI your company uses.

The gateway governs the AI you send it. Edge brings in the rest, the tools running on laptops, so all of it lives under one platform with one set of rules.

Edge + Gateway

[ WHAT IT COVERS ]

Every AI tool your team loves, now in one place. No more shadow AI.

From desktop apps to browser AI to coding tools, Edge brings every one of them under Bifrost.

[ WHO IT'S FOR ]

Built for how enterprises actually work
FOR INFRASTRUCTURE & PLATFORM TEAMS

One system for all your AI. The gateway already routes and governs your AI. Edge extends it to every AI tool across devices.

FOR SECURITY TEAMS

The same guardrails everywhere. Every AI tool runs under the same governance and security policies, on every device.

FOR AI BUILDERS

Keep the tools you love. Nothing changes in your day. No setup, no new steps.

[ UNDER THE HOOD ]

Seamless for your team.
Fully in your control.

One sign-in, and every AI request routes through Bifrost. No settings to change, no new steps for anyone.

You set what's covered

Pick which AI tools are in scope from the Bifrost console. Add new ones anytime, without touching a single laptop.

Only AI traffic is routed

Everything else on the device stays as is, and is never inspected.

Nothing changes for your team

One sign-in, no settings, no new steps. Install once and it just works.

Your governance and security runs in Bifrost

Guardrails, security policies, budgets, and access controls all run at the gateway, applied to your AI traffic by your rules.
